title: Van (composed)
description: Generated by 08-tools/build-schemas.ts from the raw schema plus registered extensions. Do not edit by hand. Regenerate with: node 08-tools/build-schemas.ts
x-no-pii: This collection holds no personal data. plateNo, routeId, status, lastLocation and batteryPct are all operational.

plateNo.description: The human plate number. The driver app shows it on the welcome card.

routeId.description: The route this van serves. Must match the routeId of the wards it visits.

lastLocation.description: The latest known position. One small doc, overwritten. Never an array.

updatedAt.description: A SERVER timestamp. Never the client clock.

currentTripId.description: The open trip's id, or null. The server owns this. A stale value here is the staleMarker conflict.

depot.description: The depot tag. The driver NEVER writes this. The dwell rule uses it to auto-end a shift.
